notifications.name: BED BUG KILLER
notifications.danger: The product contains boric acid (measured value: 5.2%) which is banned in products available to consumers since it is toxic for reproduction. Moreover, the product does not display the required warnings and hazard labels. The user therefore lacks the necessary information about the dangers. The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation nor with the Regulation on the classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures (CLP).

notifications.name: TGS, TGX
notifications.danger: Insufficiently tightened hexagonal locking nut on the steering rod of the steering column may detach under certain conditions. If the nut is completely lost, the steering system would become disconnected from the vehicle, leading to the inability to steer or control the vehicle, posing a potential risk of accidents and endangering the lives of other road users. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.name: e-tron GT, RS e-tron GT
notifications.danger: A combination of production issues (such as a torn anode tab, a folded cathode tab, a peeled-off cathode or a double production topic pouch crack) was found in some of the batteries' high-voltage modules. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.name: FUNNY RATTLE & BATHE
notifications.danger: The bath toys have small parts (squeaking elements) that can easily detach. Small children may put them in the mouth and choke.Moreover, the sound pressure level of the toy is too high (measured value up to 114.5 dB). This could lead to permanent or partial hearing loss. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.
